detailed_description:
Photorealistic CG cinematic style, like a high-end live-action drama opening. Soft afternoon sunlight. City street background with gentle bokeh.

[Shot 1] The man stands on a city sidewalk, back to the camera, looking down at his phone. He shifts his weight slightly, waiting. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the woman walks into frame from the right, a playful smile on her face. She steps up behind him and gently taps his right shoulder with her finger. [Shot 3] At 00:03.500, the man turns his head to the right, then his whole body rotates. His expression changes from neutral surprise to a wide, genuine smile. His eyes crinkle at the corners. [Shot 4] At 00:05.000, the camera pushes in slightly as the woman tilts her head and gives a warm, soft smile back. She tucks a strand of hair behind her ear. The two share a silent, happy moment. The afternoon sun casts a warm glow on their faces.

overall_soundscape: Gentle city ambience — distant traffic, soft wind. Footsteps on pavement. The light tap of the finger on the shoulder. The rustle of the trench coat as she moves. A faint bird chirp.

non_diegetic_music: A soft, warm acoustic guitar melody with a gentle piano chord progression. Light and airy, like an indie film soundtrack. A single cello note sustains through the smile exchange.
